Class GolemTransport

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.colossalchests2.golem.GolemTransport
public final class GolemTransport extends Object
Lets copper golems use colossal chests. Golems take items out through Golem walls, like from copper chests, and sort items into any chest without one, like into vanilla chests. As a chest with a Golem wall is never a destination, golems do not put items back where they took them.
